abstract_sentences.text: We study succinctness as a measure of the expressive power of transformers.

evidence.anchor: We study succinctness as a measure of the expressive power of transformers.

abstract_sentences.text: Succinctness—how compactly a formalism can describe a language relative to other formalisms—is a classical notion in logic and automata theory.
abstract_sentences.transition: defines the lens introduced in sentence 1

evidence.anchor: how compactly a formalism can describe a language relative to other formalisms

abstract_sentences.text: We prove that fixed-precision transformers are remarkably succinct: they can be exponentially more succinct than both linear temporal logic (LTL) and recurrent neural networks, and, by extension, state-space models, and doubly exponentially more succinct than finite automata.
abstract_sentences.comparison: LTL, RNNs, SSMs, and finite automata

evidence.anchor: exponentially more succinct than both linear temporal logic and recurrent neural networks

abstract_sentences.text: In other words, there exist families of languages describable by polynomial-size transformers whose smallest equivalent LTL formula or recurrent neural network is exponentially large, and whose smallest equivalent automaton is doubly exponentially large.
abstract_sentences.transition: unpacks sentence 3 into a witness-family statement

evidence.anchor: there exist families of languages describable by polynomial-size transformers

abstract_sentences.text: We also establish matching upper bounds, showing that any fixed-precision transformer can be converted to an LTL formula with at most an exponential blow-up—improving a prior doubly exponential translation.
abstract_sentences.comparison: new translation versus Yang et al. (2024)
abstract_sentences.transition: closes the lower bound with a uniform upper bound

evidence.anchor: converted to an LTL formula with at most an exponential blow-up

abstract_sentences.text: As a consequence of this succinctness, we show that basic verification problems for transformers, such as emptiness and equivalence, are provably intractable: specifically, EXPSPACE-complete.

evidence.anchor: emptiness and equivalence, are provably intractable: specifically, EXPSPACE-complete

final_judgment.single_storyline: UHAT 通过 attention 编码双指数 counter；shortest-witness 长度把该构造转成对 LTL/RNN 的指数、对 automata 的双指数 succinctness 下界，值域上界与 LTL translation 给出 matching upper bound，并导出 EXPSPACE verification complexity。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留全部 definitions、counter intuition、reduction/translation dependency graph、所有 named theorem statements，以及 Theorems 15/17 的关键 witness proofs。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: A.1–A.7 承担 tiling gadgets、B-RASP→UHAT、precision bound、UHAT↔LTL 和 equivalence 的完整证明；约为正文 65.5% 的词量。
final_judgment.best_pattern: 最有效模式是先用 Example 2 展示 4-bit counter，再把同一机制扩展到 tiling hardness、shortest witness 和 succinctness theorem；局部公式直接服务全局 proof chain。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 标题和摘要使用宽泛的 “transformers”，正式定理针对 UHAT；作者在结尾明确 softmax/average-hard succinctness 尚未解决。SSM 的 “by extension” 也缺少单独形式化桥梁。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 理论论文的正文应保留 witness mechanism、依赖图与可决策的 theorem statements；把长 induction/gadget algebra 放入被正文精确调用的 appendix。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该模式适合读者可从主文重建 proof strategy 的形式理论；若关键假设、模型外推或唯一 correctness argument 只在脚注/附录出现，正文会失去自足性。
